title: BaseSoundLibrary
description: Base sound library (B8-4, B2530): recorded or generated sound files for sound ids of the sound map, with origin and licence per file, loudness targets the files are normalised to, and sound and context words that map a short sound description from the rule guardian to a base sound when no generated sound exists (fallback). Sound ids without a file here use the retro synth recipes.

fallback_min_score.description: Smallest score of the fallback from a sound description (sound word 2, context word 1). Below it the object stays silent rather than sounding wrong.

LibraryTarget.description: Loudness and length rules every library file meets (checked by a test).

one_shot_dbfs.description: Gated RMS loudness of single sounds (dBFS).

loop_dbfs.description: Gated RMS loudness of loops (dBFS); quieter, they run for long.

gate_dbfs.description: Frames (50 ms) below this level do not count for the loudness.

one_shot_max_s.description: Longest single sound (B2530: a few seconds).

clean_gain_db.description: Files raised by more than this when normalising get the gentle noise gate first (TL #19652).

clean_floor_dbfs.description: Files whose noise floor would end above this after normalising get the gentle noise gate first.

LibraryOrigin.description: Where files come from: an official CC0 pack, a local model, or own work. The licence must be on the approved list (B2482).

archive_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the downloaded archive; null for files generated here (model revision in the name).

id.description: Sound id as used in the sound map (e.g. step.grass, object.fire).

files.description: Variants (one is picked per play); 16-bit PCM WAV below game/assets/sound/base.

sound_words.description: Words that name the sound itself (creak, crackle, splash): count 2 each in the fallback from a sound description.

context_words.description: Words that only name the setting or material (wood, water, door): count 1 each; alone they never reach the minimum score.

source.description: File in the origin's archive, or the generator's output name.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the WAV in the repository (after normalising).

prompt.description: Prompt for generated files (null for recorded ones), so they can be made again.

seed.description: Seed for generated files; null for recorded ones.

origin.description: Origin of this file when it differs from the sound's origin (A and B chosen as variants). Must be the id of an entry in this file's `origins` list (checked by BaseSoundCheck).

noise_floor_dbfs.description: Noise floor of the file in the repository (10th percentile of 50 ms frames, dBFS); null for files shorter than 1 s, where it would only measure the sound itself (their silent tails are trimmed).

cleaned.description: True if the noise gate ran before normalising.
